evidence_spans.source_text: Hippocam combines this breadth with stronger overall performance, leading or tying on seven of the eight measures. evidence_spans.source_text: ToolBench accuracy falls from 78.7% to 65.7% (Table 4). ALFWorld success remains near perfect, but mean actions increase from 9.62 to 11.74, and episode-start context grows from 19.7k to 50.7k tokens in the inspected stream.

Context-size statistics describe the first main-agent request of each episode in the inspected ALFWorld stream, including its preceding experience-acquisition segment; they do not measure total inference tokens.
